## Activity

During May 2025, Central Eye Clinic recorded 212 captures. Activity was completed as planned, with session lists operating as expected apart from routine leave. The available activity record indicates that capture work continued across the reporting period without any other noted operational variation.

## Image quality

Image quality review identified 4 captures that could not be graded. This represents an ungradable rate of 1.9 per cent. The result provides a summary of the proportion of images requiring exclusion from grading because they were not suitable for assessment.

## Grading

Grading identified 60 referable results during the month. The median lag between capture and grading was 2 days. This measure summarises the time from the completed capture to the availability of the grading outcome. Together, the grading results and turnaround information provide an overview of referral activity and reporting timeliness for Central Eye Clinic during May 2025.
